subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should this PR, after rebasing over current transcript-helper changes, make WebChat's unresumable restart notice a persistent delivery-mirror transcript row?
rationale: The code path fixes a real missing-notice bug, but it changes persisted session history and touches path-sensitive transcript targeting while adjacent restart-recovery storage work remains open.

options.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Fallback
options.body: Rebase over current main, preserve the current append-helper guards, and land the fallback as the WebChat failure-notice contract.

options.title: Request Live WebChat Proof
options.body: Ask for a short Control UI restart/reconnect capture before merge if maintainers want rendered UI evidence in addition to disk-transcript tests.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the SQLite restart-recovery route or recover-and-continue UX to define the durable notice contract first.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Fallback
recommendation.body: Rebase over current main, preserve the current append-helper guards, and land the fallback as the WebChat failure-notice contract.
